 Versus
 The State Of Assam
Represented By The Public Prosecutor, Assam
Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. M R KHANDAKAR Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  Page No.# 2/3
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MITALI THAKURIA  ORDER 15.05.2024 Heard Mr. M. R. Khandakar, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. P.
Sharma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.
This is an application filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, praying for grant of pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioner in connection with Mankachar P. S. Case No.438/2023 [corresponding to G. R. Case No.1058/2023] under Sections 448/376(1)/506 of the Indian Penal Code.
The Case Diary has been received and I have perused the same.

It is submitted by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Mr. P. Sharma that though the Case Diary has been received, but the last entry was made on 07.12.2023 and the interim bail was granted Ahammad Ali @ Ahmed Ali vs The State Of Assam on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138940452/
1 on 04.04.2024 and therefore, the statement of the accused/petitioner is not available in the Case Diary.

sentences.text: Further, he submitted that the order of interim pre-arrest bail is available in the Case Diary from which presumption can be made that the petitioner must have appeared before the IO after obtaining the pre-arrest bail.

In this regard, Mr. Khandakar, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the accused/petitioner has stated that he had already appeared before the IO and recorded his statement and thus, he accordingly, prays for calling the updated Case Diary at this stage.
Considering the submissions made by the learned counsels for both sides, call for the updated Case Diary fixing 10.06.2024.
Page No.# 3/3 Till then, the interim order passed earlier shall be continued.
